sentences.sentence: When squares containing most of the octopuses' mantles were compared to equally sized areas by examining the entire image at single pixel intervals, areas of high resemblance were detected ( Figure 1B, 1D ).
These high resemblance areas matched distinct features and objects in the immediate surroundings but not the entire viewed area or large portions of it.

“Multi-point”

 Analysing the same 11 images of free ranging octopuses using the multi-point method ( Figure 2c ) showed that a) octopuses displayed body patterns significantly different from each other (Kruskal Wallis test; P<0.01), b) octopus body patterns resembled specific structures in their immediate surroundings (Mann Whitney U test n = 30, P>0.05), and c) such similarity was not found when comparing the octopuses to the ‘general substrate’ sections in the images (P<0.01).
